resources.string: Connect an account to back up
Connect a Google account to keep your photos and videos safe.
No device photos to back up
%1$d backed up · %2$d remaining on this device
No photos or videos match this view.

✓ Backed up: saved to a connected Google account.
↑ Backing up: preparing, checking, or uploading the original.
◷ Waiting: queued for a backup worker or waiting for Wi-Fi.
Cloud off: not backed up.
! Failed: needs a retry; open the photo for the reason.
Counts describe photos and videos this app can access on this phone. A cloud refresh does not back up device photos.
No connected account has enough free space for this file. Free space or connect another account.
Allow access to this photo or video, then try backup again.
Reconnect your Google account and grant Drive access, then retry.
The file could not be read or the connection was interrupted. Check your connection and retry.
Google Drive could not complete the upload. Try again later.
This file could not be backed up. Check account access and available storage, then retry.
Only selected photos are accessible · Manage access
Saved to your connected Google Drive library.
This item has not finished backing up. Waiting for the next backup worker or an available connection.
This item is only on this device. Back it up to save a cloud copy.
The original is being prepared, checked, or uploaded. It is marked backed up only after Google Drive confirms it.
